text:
maria-support: Customer ticket #4567 — multiple customers reporting spikes of 503 / long tail latency. They say requests to eu-west are getting routed to us-east and timing out. Can someone triage?

alex-eng: seeing the same in internal dashboard. eu-west GPU pool reports queueing and some requests are being overflowed to fallback routing. Noticed fallback picks a smaller quantized variant in us-east.

kyle-infra: @alex-eng can you paste an example request/headers? need to confirm x-redwood-region and routing decision.

alex-eng: here's one from the customer trace id=trace-8a3f: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_******
X-Client-Region: eu-west
Accept: application/json
```
Response headers: `x-redwood-region: us-east-1`, `x-routing-reason: capacity_spillover`, status 503 after 12s.

maria-support: Customer says they had region pinning set in their dashboard to eu-west, so this is unexpected. They also got a 401 once when a fallback model in us-east attempted inference — maybe token scopes differ?

eng-oncall: @kyle-infra I'll need routing logs for that trace. Run the routing lookup for trace-8a3f and grep for policy evaluation. Also check model-permission mapping between regions.

kyle-infra: pulled logs: `routing_event: trace-8a3f, src_region=eu-west, selected_region=us-east, policy=latency_cost_balance, fallback_reason=queue_full(gpu-pool-eu-west-3), final_model=redwood-small-8q`

alex-eng: That matches. Two notes: (1) spillover happened because pool eu-west-3 reached its inflight request limit, queueing threshold triggered. (2) fallback model is a different family and the customer's API key doesn't have access to some private model variants in us-east — leads to mixed 401/403 behavior.

maria-support: Customer angry about cross-region latency and unexpected billing implications. They were charged egress + higher per-token rates for the fallback model. Need resolution and clear repro for engineering.

eng-oncall: Action items — (A) temporarily pin the customer's requests to eu-west to stop spillover (config change on routing table), (B) surface clearer header in responses when fallback occurs (x-routing-reason already exists, but make it more visible to users), (C) add a fallback auth check earlier to return 429 or a deterministic error instead of 401 mid-request.

kyle-infra: I can apply a pin for customer_id=crm-233 for next 2 hours: `rbac route-pin --customer crm-233 --region eu-west --ttl 7200` — doing it now.

ops-bot: route-pin: success for crm-233 -> eu-west (ttl 7200s).

alex-eng: For repro steps for ENG: 1) configure a synthetic load to saturate eu-west pool (use loadgen: --region eu-west --concurrency 300), 2) issue a request with the customer's API key and X-Client-Region eu-west and observe `x-routing-reason: capacity_spillover` and region swap, 3) check for mixed auth errors in fallback path. I'll attach a small script in the ticket.

maria-support: Also please add notes for CS: how to explain to customer — short answer: automatic spillover is allowed by default to maintain availability, but can cause cross-region routing and different model variants; we can pin region or increase dedicated capacity to prevent it.

eng-oncall: Will follow up with infra on increasing the inflight threshold and adding an early auth check. Kyle — please collect all trace ids for last 24h with `fallback_reason=queue_full` and post them in this thread.

kyle-infra: Running query now, will post list in ~10m.

maria-support: Thanks all. Customer wants ETA on permanent fix / docs update so they can decide if they want to move to Dedicated. Marking P2 for now, escalating to product for fallback UX docs. :wave:

eng-oncall: Noted. Leaving this open until we have metrics on whether spike recurs and until product drafts the doc.

kyle-infra: posted traces: trace-8a3f, trace-8a4c, trace-8b01, trace-8b27 (all show queue_full on eu-west pools in last 6 hours).

alex-eng: I'll use those to reproduce locally. If anyone needs the sample curl + loadgen script ping me.

maria-support: Closing the support loop with the customer: told them temporary pin is applied and ops team is investigating permanent remediation. Customer acknowledged but requested timeline. I'll update ticket with this thread. :thumbsup:
